utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Case Number IT-01-42/1-A, The Prosecutor versus Miodrag Jokic. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you. For the appellant, the appearances, please. Counsel for the appellant.

utterances.speaker: MR. NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Good afternoon to my colleagues of the Prosecution. My name is Zarko Nikolic, and I'm representing the Defence this afternoon for Admiral Miodrag Jokic. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you very much, Mr. Nikolic. Mr. Jokic, can you understand us? THE APPELLANT: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Yes, I can understand you. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you. Appearances for the Prosecution, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. LAMB
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. My name is Susan Lamb, and I along with my colleague, Mr. Norman Farrell, and our case manager, Ms. Susan Grogan, appear for the Prosecution. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you very much. So the first information I want to give you on behalf of the Bench is that the hearing will take place in the last week of February or beginning of March. Having said this, I would like to know if the appellant, Mr. Nikolic, or Mr. Jokic want to raise anything.

utterances.speaker: MR. NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] On behalf of the Defence team, Your Honour, I can say at this point in time, the Defence has nothing to raise. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you very much, Mr. Nikolic. Mr. Jokic, do you want to raise anything? THE APPELLANT: [Interpretation] Your Honour, no, I have nothing to raise. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you. The Prosecution?

utterances.speaker: MS. LAMB
utterances.text: Your Honour, the Prosecution also has nothing further to raise. We would simply like, however, to thank you for the advance notice of the hearing. Thank you. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you, Ms. Lamb. So then this Status Conference is adjourned.
